scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client && prettier --check api tests scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client && npm run test:proxy
